_note: The link lives here and nowhere else. build.mjs substitutes it into every video's description, pinned comment and caption, so changing it once changes every video from then on. Paste the free $0 Gumroad product URL into leadMagnet when it exists.
_note2: baseTags are merged after each video's own hashtags into the YouTube tags, inside the 500-char cap. communities is the default seeding-pack trio when the sheet row leaves `communities` blank.
_note3: photos: default Pixabay search per scene type when a row's photo cell is blank, as `term @category` (category is one of Pixabay's: computer, buildings, business, backgrounds, industry, places, science). Objects only, never people — the channel is faceless. `none` in the cell = no backdrop. Card scenes (prompt, terminal, posting, rejection, comp, market) never get one.
